# Meeting text · Rc42670a01a

## Summary

The client is a 62-year-old retired entrepreneur (Emekli girişimci) with a conservative risk profile (Muhafazakâr) and an investment horizon of 1-3 years. The client's assets are described as "Varlığı TL mevduat ağırlıklı", and the file note says the client wants to understand alternatives that could reduce the concentration in deposits. The client asked about monthly cash flow, and the goal is "Düzenli gelir ve sermayenin korunmasını önceliklendirmek"; the aim of the meeting is to discuss the three selected funds against the ING Turuncu Hesap (standart). This text is meeting preparation for the RM; it is not investment advice.

## Talking points

- **Mevduatta reel getiri:** The market average deposit rate is 43.82% (TCMB EVDS, 2026-10-02); after withholding tax and inflation of 29.73% (2026-09-30), it gives a real return of about +4.9% per year.
- **Alternatif:** NUROL PORTFÖY PARA PİYASASI (TL) FONU returned about +7.4% after inflation over the last year; past returns do not show future returns.
- **Paraya erişim:** For the first three options, access to money is the same day, which matters for a client who wants to keep liquidity.

## Options to discuss

- NUROL PORTFÖY PARA PİYASASI (TL) FONU is a money market fund with a 1-year return of 47.60% (past return), risk level 1 out of 7 and 10,366 investors.
- It serves the client's priority "likiditeyi koruma" with same-day access, and the low risk level fits the "yüksek riskli ürünlerden kaçınma" constraint; watch that the return is a past figure.
- İSTANBUL PORTFÖY KISA VADELİ BORÇLANMA ARAÇLARI (TL) FONU is a short-term debt instruments fund with a 1-year return of 47.14% (past return), risk level 1 out of 7 and 2,734 investors.
- It speaks to "düzenli gelir", the client's stated goal of regular income, and the monthly cash flow question; watch that its investor base is smaller than the other two selected funds.
- AK PORTFÖY PARA PİYASASI KATILIM FONU is a participation money market fund with a 1-year return of 46.26% (past return), risk level 1 out of 7 and 26,708 investors.
- It serves "sınırlı dalgalanma" with its risk level of 1 out of 7 and offers a participation-type option alongside the other two; watch that its 1-year return is the lowest of the three selected funds.

## Alternatives

- Other money market funds are ONE PORTFÖY PARA PİYASASI (TL) FONU at 49.68%, ZİRAAT PORTFÖY BAŞAK PARA PİYASASI (TL) FONU at 46.86% and ALLBATROSS PORTFÖY BİRİNCİ PARA PİYASASI (TL) FONU at 51.41% over one year (past returns).
- Other debt funds are AK PORTFÖY İKİNCİ KISA VADELİ BORÇLANMA ARAÇLARI (TL) FONU at 46.91% and OSMANLI PORTFÖY ÖZEL SEKTÖR BORÇLANMA ARAÇLARI FONU at 48.36% over one year (past returns).
- Other participation funds are GARANTİ PORTFÖY PARA PİYASASI KATILIM (TL) FONU at 45.96% and NUROL PORTFÖY PARA PİYASASI KATILIM FONU at 46.15% over one year (past returns).
- For comparison, ING Turuncu Hesap (standart) pays 23.00%, while the market average deposit rate is 43.82% (TCMB EVDS, 2026-10-02).

## Points to watch

- Past returns do not show future returns, and fund values can change.

## Questions

- Ask the client to confirm the constraint "yüksek riskli ürünlerden kaçınma".
- Ask how much monthly cash flow the client expects, since the client asked about it.
- Ask how much of the current deposits the client would consider moving, given the 1-3 year horizon.

## Proposal script

You told us your aim is "Düzenli gelir ve sermayenin korunmasını önceliklendirmek", and that your assets are mostly in TL deposits. We can look at three low-risk funds that offer same-day access, so you can see how they compare with your deposit and what they mean for your monthly cash flow. Their returns are past returns and do not show the future; which parts suit you is your decision.

## Assumptions

- Fon getirileri geçmiş getirilerdir; mevduat oranı bugünkü orandır.
- Getiriler stopaj sonrası ve yıllık TÜFE'ye (%29.73, 2026-09-30) göre reel olarak hesaplandı.
- Mevduat için 100.000-249.999 TL diliminin standart oranı kullanıldı (tutar bilinmiyor; hoş geldin oranı geçicidir).
- Fonlarda likidite satış valöründen (valör yoksa ürün türünden), gelir uygunluğu ürün türünden türetildi.
- Hisse senedi yoğun fonlarda stopaj %0'dır; ihtiyatlı olmak için para piyasası dışındaki tüm fonlarda 'diğer fonlar' oranı kullanıldı.
- 32 günlük vade her ay yenilenir; oranlar değişebilir.
